definitions.correct_candidate: Emitted candidate box IoU>=0.5; un-clipped candidate boxes as used by training labels.
definitions.selected_and_keep: Actual clipped online output and same-state clipped local candidate0, both rounded to3 decimals, IoU against GT.
definitions.failure: IoU<0.2; an event ends at IoU>=0.5. Delay counts actual frame indices.
definitions.ground_truth: Initialization excluded; diagnostic decisions use finite GT with positive width/height. GT with x/y=0 remains a box; this diagnostic mask differs from native official PR/NPR/SR.
definitions.commits: Actual per-sensor template and target-memory gates; erroneous writes use selected IoU<0.2 as a localization proxy, not semantic identity labels.
definitions.harm_scope: Immediate same-state rescue/harm does not capture later recovery-opportunity losses or provide a causal future comparison.
definitions.rates: Null means denominator0, not zero error. Modal write counts include all tracked frames; pollution denominators use valid GT only.
